_comment: Lane 2 fault-catalog ledger — every taxonomy class vs its verification status. Refreshed for the INTEGRATED tree (contract/lane0-spine + contract/lane05-supervision + contract/lane1-compiler + contract/lane2-harness) per spec-review round 2 F5. See docs/product/lane2-spec-mismatches.md for why the plan's '30 always-green JSON files' is replaced by 'runnable scenario for classes whose retiring mechanism exists here + honest pending/cross-lane rows for the rest'. status: verified_here (red-green proven by a scenario in THIS branch's engine) | partial (a scenario proves one half; the rest is pending — see pending_remainder) | verified_lane_1 / verified_lane_0_5 (proven by another lane's committed suite — see verified_by for cited test paths; NOT runnable from this worktree until integration) | pending_lane_N (retiring seam unbuilt on any branch; a scenario would be red-only) | delegated_lane_6. The verified_by citations name real committed tests on the cited lane branch@commit; run them there to reproduce.
